values.meaning: maximum damage increase percentage based on distance traveled

mechanics.claim: Devastating Charge resets Hecarim's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Devastating Charge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Hecarim's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Devastating Charge's damage will apply life steal and will affect structures.
mechanics.quote: ''Devastating Charge's'' damage will apply {{sti|life steal|link=true}} and will affect structures.

mechanics.claim: Devastating Charge's damage will not bypass block or dodge but the knock back will still be applied.
mechanics.quote: ''Devastating Charge's'' damage will not bypass {{tip|block}} or {{tip|dodge}} but the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} will still be applied.

mechanics.claim: Devastating Charge still deals damage while the caster is blinded.
mechanics.quote: ''Devastating Charge'' will still deal damage while {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: If the target does not remain nearby during the dash, Devastating Charge's effect will not be consumed.
mechanics.quote: If the target does not remain nearby during the dash, ''Devastating Charge's'' effect will not be consumed.

mechanics.claim: Devastating Charge will still apply its effects to the target even if the dash is interrupted, but not if he goes into resurrection.
mechanics.quote: ''Devastating Charge'' will still apply its effects to the target even if the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, but not if he goes into {{tip|resurrection}}.

mechanics.claim: Hecarim can cast any of his abilities while dashing, but Onslaught of Shadows will interrupt the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Hecarim''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] while {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
